payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes row/column coverage counts for all eraser placements using sliding window updates in O(1) per shift, then brute-force maximizes over positions.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sliding window to maintain counts of rows/columns that become all-white under the eraser, shifting row window vertically and column window horizontally with amortized constant-time updates. No DP recurrence or memoization.
